notes:
The Launch E-Sys button stays in view with many cars in the garage.
Updating no longer asks you to close E-Sys that another program started. Only an E-Sys opened with E-Sys MAX has to be closed first.
Service functions and Service reset no longer need E-Sys closed, also for remote cars. Only when E-Sys is connected to the car, press Disconnect in E-Sys first.
